assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Scalene triangle ABC with sides a, b, c labelled and its three angle bisectors dashed; their feet M on BC, N on CA and P on AB form the blue shaded triangle MNP, and the three corner triangles ANP, BPM and CMN are shaded yellow.

difficulty_rationale: Subtracting the three corner triangles and using the angle bisector theorem is a natural plan, but it needs several connected steps and a symmetric factorisation at the end.
